asset: Hokkaido bear sculpt v14 — genuine official Harness GLB, Blender Cycles four-view preview
reviewer: ChatGPT visual review of actual official 3DCodeVerse GLB rendered by Blender Cycles; four views inspected

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: One-piece bulky quadruped and thick head improve basic proportions, but neck, shoulders, rump and barrel are too uniform and toy-like rather than recognizable carved grizzly anatomy.

face_and_expression.reason: Eyes are tiny or hidden, no clearly sculpted eyelid and eye socket profile, the large rounded snout conceals the bite geometry.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: Large pale fish is still suspended directly across the mouth; no visible upper/lower jaw clamping fish, fish tail and fins remain flat triangular extrusions.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: Brown material looks like matte clay or wax; virtually no legible hand-chisel cut grain or multi-scale directional fur carving.

paws_and_limbs.reason: Feet are thicker and previously long wired claws are shorter, but the paws look like blunt socks and toe anatomy remains simple blobs.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Four real Blender Cycles render views now produced and framed; lighting is legible but lacks close-up diagnostic shots of face and bite.

defects.finding: Fish appears simply held in front of nose with no convincing upper/lower mouth closure.
defects.required_fix: Create a deep jaw recess and physically separated upper/lower lips that visibly overlap salmon's dorsal and ventral contours in front and profile views.

defects.finding: Oversized featureless helmet-like skull; eyes lost in surface.
defects.required_fix: Create eye sockets on true external head surface, raised eyebrows, deep cheeks, wider triangular muzzle and readable nose.

defects.finding: Smooth clay/matte brown shell without credible directional hand-carved fur and chisel planes.
defects.required_fix: Add 3D sculpted multi-scale directional gouges grouped by anatomical region and stained highlights, then bake to normals.

defects.finding: Salmon reads as a plank/torpedo with simple thin triangular fins, shallow facial features and disproportionately prominent body.
defects.required_fix: Remodel anatomically recognizable salmon head, gill plate, lower jaw, rounded fins, dorsal ridge, stalk and tapered forked tail. Deepen fish scale cuts.

defects.finding: Legs are still cylinders and paws have little tendon/toe structure.
defects.required_fix: Sculpt stocky but tapered muscular legs and four distinctly carved fused toes per paw; shorten protruding tips.

improvement_tasks: Focus next revision exclusively on true jaw-to-salmon bite and readable eyes/nose; do not spend time on texture resolution.
Replace regular torso barrel with deeper shoulder hump that tapers continuously to rump.
Improve anatomically believable fish gill, tail, fins and position; inspect same four real GLB views.
Create directional hand-chisel surface relief only after macro anatomy passes.
Preserve current official Harness => Blender Cycles actual GLB multiview => fail-closed supervisor pipeline.
Never mark as delivered unless all six criteria average >=4/5, every individual criterion >=3, and no critical/blocker defects remain.
